Daniel Island Sunday Ride

Charleston, SC · Daniel Island · Road

No-dropBeginner friendly

Daniel Island Sunday Ride is a road group ride in Charleston, SC. It rolls every Sunday at 10:00 am from Guggenheim Park. About 12 / 18 / 30 miles, 14–16 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Daniel Island Sunday Ride group ride

No-drop Sunday ride with three distance options so you can bail early. Fourteen to sixteen miles an hour. Moves to 2 pm in the winter months.
